intro: Lesson 58: Constructing triangles with compasses: three sides (SSS). To understand how to construct a triangle from three sides using a ruler and compasses

model.title: Construct triangle ABC with AB = 6 cm, BC = 5 cm and AC = 4 cm.

parts.label: Step 2
parts.text: Set compasses to 4 cm: arc from A

parts.label: Step 3
parts.text: Set compasses to 5 cm: arc from B

parts.label: Step 4
parts.text: Join A and B to the crossing point C

questions.q: Construct an equilateral triangle with sides of 7 cm.
questions.model: Draw 7 cm. Keep the compasses at 7 cm and draw an arc from each end. Join both ends to the crossing point: all sides 7 cm, so all angles 60°.

questions.q: Construct triangle PQR with PQ = 8 cm, QR = 6 cm and PR = 10 cm. Measure the largest angle.
Can 2.5 cm, 3.5 cm and 6 cm make a triangle?
questions.a: No: 2.5 + 3.5 = 6, so it would lie flat.

questions.q: Construct each triangle with ruler and compasses, leaving the arcs, and measure the largest angle: (a) 5 cm, 5 cm, 5 cm (b) 7 cm, 4 cm, 5 cm (c) 9 cm, 6 cm, 6 cm
questions.model: (b) Draw the longest side, 7 cm, first. Arc of 4 cm from one end, arc of 5 cm from the other; join both ends to the crossing. The largest angle is opposite the 7 cm side.

questions.q: Construct a kite with sides 5 cm, 5 cm, 8 cm and 8 cm whose short diagonal is 6 cm.
questions.a: Draw the 6 cm diagonal; arcs of 5 cm from both ends on one side and 8 cm from both ends on the other; join.

questions.q: A triangle has sides of 4 cm, 9 cm and x cm, where x is a whole number. List every possible value of x.
questions.a: 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 (x must be more than 5 and less than 13)
